Dear Mr. Petrakis,

Thank you for your questions about the Q4 forecast. The revised figure of $4.2 million reflects the delayed Halston contract, which now closes in January rather than December. Excluding that one item, the quarter tracks within 2 percent of the original plan.

Ms. Chen will walk through the detail at the finance review on November 19. I have attached the bridge she prepared.

Regards,
Isabel Moreau
